name: Mending Cant
description: Heal 5 party HP. The Essence price is the cap; no per-expedition charge limit.

name: Purifying Rite
description: Suppress corruption attrition for the party's next 10 steps.

name: Wayfarer's Beacon
description: Mark the current tile; the mark stays visible for the rest of the expedition.

name: Campward
description: The next Rest site used heals +50% and grants +2 additional Essence.
